text: An empty screen can mean three different things: the tool looked and found nothing worth making, it did not look at all, or it broke along the way. Each of those calls for a different next step, so a screen that blurs them leaves the reader guessing. On 12 September 2026, a product-experience review of a ShortsOS build found exactly that blur: a failed analysis was silently discarded, and an honest result of no strong opportunities looked the same as a page that had never been analyzed. The build was held back until a narrow fix passed a second review.
